svg.text: CADET export only: where the feed starts and ends (D19, D21)
Synthetic run logs put through pycorn.exporters.cadet.build_experiment. The tables don't do this; they show the valve as logged.
Numbered marks: run-log entries, listed under each case with their stored (elapsed) time; the x axis is the wall clock CADET uses.
1a. Loop injection, no loop volume given
The whole Inject period counts as feed (warning). Note the 3 s at the old 5 ml/min: the phase-start carry-over, kept exact.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
180 s elapsed: Injection valve Manual load
Feed ends when 0.5 ml of system flow has gone through the loop (0.25 ml at 5 ml/min + 0.25 ml at 1 ml/min); buffer follows.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
180 s elapsed: Injection valve Manual load
2a. Direct inject, sample inlet switched to Buffer, no sample_path_volume
The feed ends at the switch (warning: up to one path volume of sample is missing).
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
60 s elapsed: Injection valve Direct inject
240 s elapsed: Injection valve Manual load
The path still holds 0.5 ml of sample at the switch: at 1 ml/min the feed runs 30 s longer.
wall-clock s from method start (pauses included)
60 s elapsed: Injection valve Direct inject
240 s elapsed: Injection valve Manual load
